description: Effective-dated, never-mutate, versioned price book for one Client (optionally one Branch Site) and service line. Resolves each billable component to a day rate / fee via a per-line day-rate basis (C3). A revision is always a NEW version, never an in-place edit of an active card. Real money values live only in the Component / Penalty rows and are seeded out-of-repo; the committed structure carries the enums and effectivity only.

fields.description: Unique card id, convention client::service_line::v{n} (e.g. CLIENT-delivery-v3). Set once and never changed; a revision is a new card with a bumped version.
fields.label: Rate Card Name

fields.description: Optional. Leave blank for a client-wide card, or set for a branch-specific one.
fields.label: Branch Site

fields.description: Which operational line this card prices.
fields.label: Service Line

fields.description: Stock ERPNext Contract that anchors the client, the period and the delegation of authority. Optional at draft.
fields.label: Contract

fields.description: Lifecycle state. Only draft / pending-approval cards may be edited; activating a version supersedes the prior one. An active or superseded card is immutable.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Dimension 1 - the unit each line is billed in. Day-rate basis becomes mandatory per line when this is package_day or attendance_day.
fields.label: Billing Unit

fields.description: Dimension 2 - how the rate is structured.
fields.label: Rate Structure

fields.description: D2 - how a government levy is charged on this card. The rate value itself is stored on the levy Component Row and seeded out-of-repo.
fields.label: Levy Basis

fields.description: D3 - how the service charge fee is charged on this card. The rate value itself is stored on the charge-fee Component Row and seeded out-of-repo.
fields.label: Charge Fee Basis

fields.description: Dimension 3 - which billing components this card actually charges (basic, allowances, GOSI, OT, levy, charge fee, EOS, VAT). Every enabled component must have at least one Rate Line.
fields.label: Enabled Components

fields.description: First date this card version prices a period. Immutable once set; a change of effectivity is a new version.
fields.label: Effective From

fields.description: Version number, bumped on every revision. The prior version is retained and superseded, never overwritten. Set once per card.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Optional close date. Leave blank for an open-ended card; superseding sets it on the prior version.
fields.label: Effective To

fields.description: One line per priced component. Each line carries its own day-rate basis (C3) and its seeded money value.
fields.label: Rate Lines

fields.description: Performance / attendance penalty parameters consumed by the reconciliation engine. A performance-adjusted card needs at least one penalty row.
fields.label: Penalties

name: Rate Card
